summary: UY Scuti Acquisition Corp., a Cayman blank-check company listed on Nasdaq, filed an 8-K after depositing $450,000 into its IPO trust account on September 30, 2026, extending its deadline to consummate an initial business combination under its amended articles and trust agreement. The payment was funded by a loan from Isdera HK Limited, an affiliate of merger counterparty Isdera Group, with a promissory note expected. The filing follows a September 22, 2026 joinder and First Amendment to the July 18, 2025 merger agreement with Isdera Group and Xinghui Automotive Technology (Hainan) shareholders. Watch extension runway, note terms, and redemption levels.
